races.display_title: Market Square Monasterevin Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict: BENOWN made a promising start to his career when runner-up here last month, beaten only by a more streetwise rival, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Controlla is feared most dropped into a maiden for the first time, while Heralds March is one to note with his debut run behind him. BENOWN (IRE) CONTROLLA (IRE) HERALDS MARCH (IRE)

Lewis Carroll remains unexposed and can't be discounted after an absence, while Oro Blanco also needs factoring into this competitive event. races.verdict: COME WHAT MAY stands out on paper being a brother to the high-class winner up to 1½m Desert Crown and gets the nod to make a belated winning debut before market clues. Kenough showed promise first time up at this venue back in the spring and is a likely improver upped in trip, while Leopold The First is an obvious contender back in maiden company providing he casts aside a lesser effort last time. COME WHAT MAY (IRE) KENOUGH (FR) LEOPOLD THE FIRST (IRE)

races.verdict: TOGETHER NOW showed plenty when runner-up in a 7f maiden here a year ago (Oaks winner Thundering On back in fourth) and this half-sister to City of Troy can start making up for lost time with fitness unlikely to be an issue. Goddess of War is worth another chance to confirm debut promise so is second choice, while Emberelle isn't taken lightly after her eye-catching debut at Navan. races.verdict: BLAZE THE WAY wasn't disgraced in valuable handicaps at the end of last season and, now just 1 lb above his last winning mark, is taken to resume winning ways returned to these calmer waters. A Penny A Hundred returned to form at Galway from a lenient mark and is feared most. West Away ran well from out of the weights when third at Killarney last month and is also one to consider. BLAZE THE WAY (IRE) A PENNY A HUNDRED (FR) WEST AWAY (IRE)
